$description: Iconography guidelines. gwds.app doesn't ship a custom icon set today — this documents the intended system so a design tool can seed a library.

style.visual_weight: consistent across icons — all look like siblings at 16px

recommended_sources.name: Lucide
recommended_sources.notes: Preferred — matches the stroke-based style exactly.

recommended_sources.name: Tabler Icons
recommended_sources.notes: Drop-in alternative with a larger set.

GWDS_wave_mark.description: Stylized gamma-wave mark — treat as the only icon that breaks the grid rules.

do: Use the 24-px grid even at larger sizes.
Pair icons with labels whenever meaning is non-obvious.
Color with a single token; don't multicolor.
dont: Mix two icon libraries in one surface.
Hang icons outside their padding box.
Animate them unless there's a clear affordance reason.
